description: Introduces two new ships, a gameplay system involving mobile upgradable battle colonies, and four short missions. It modifies pirate interactions so they request resources rather than attacking immediately.
descriptionHtml: Introduces two new ships, a gameplay system involving mobile upgradable battle colonies, and four short missions. It modifies pirate interactions so they request resources rather than attacking immediately.
discordPostHtml:
after 9 years in development I return to you with 2 new ships, 1 halfbaked gameplay system and 4 short missions
making this a vanilla-quality mod

Main Features:

  • Mobile, upgradable battle colonies
  • Some interesting ships and weapons
  • Pirates now ask for your stuff instead of going for the throat straight up

If unsure about whether or not the mod is good just ask around in I'm sure they'll know.
